reels.caption: Julia Polastri KO’s Jingnan UFC Shangai. #juliapolastri
good: Strong visual hook: fighter in octagon with immediate action context
Bold, readable text overlay with fighter name and achievement (NOCAUTEIA)
Professional broadcast-quality production with UFC/Monster branding
Clear narrative: caption 'KO's Jingnan' sets expectation for knockout content
bad: Moderate reach for UFC highlight (5.8K views): engagement and saves are weak (8 saves)
Unclear finish moment: early frame shows fighting position, not the actual knockout impact
Celebration frame lacks triumphant reaction shot: smile is subdued, not victory energy
Engagement drops early (6.1s avg watch suggests viewers leave before emotional payoff)
reels.top_tip: Lead with the knockout moment + fighter's triumphant reaction (fist pump, celebration) in first 1-2 seconds before showing the fight action; current hook shows action but not victory emotion, missing the shareability trigger that drives saves and reshares
